# Artik Lab

> Artik Lab builds AI capabilities that remain inside the company: measurable processes, governance, operational training, agentic data analysis and controlled prototypes.

## Guides and main pages
- [Artik Lab](https://ar-tik.com/en/index.md): Artik Lab helps companies and business functions choose, govern and deliver the first useful use of AI: process mapping, business cases, team training, data analysis and controlled prototypes.
- [AI applications atlas](https://ar-tik.com/en/ai-applications-atlas.md): A public map of concrete examples to recognise where artificial intelligence can reduce time, errors, risk or decision delays in company workflows.
- [Corporate AI FAQ](https://ar-tik.com/en/ai-business-faq.md): A public question set for owners, leaders and business functions choosing between consulting, courses, data analysis, technical software and the AI applications Atlas.

## Services
- [AI management consulting](https://ar-tik.com/en/ai-management-consulting.md): AI is not software to install: it is a management capability to build. Artik Lab helps leadership decide where to use it, where to stop, which processes to redesign and which skills must remain inside the company.
- [Agentic data analysis](https://ar-tik.com/en/agentic-data-analysis.md): Agentic data analysis does not produce charts to archive: it finds signals in already available data, connects them to a decision and states where the model is not worth building.
- [Technical AI software](https://ar-tik.com/en/technical-software-development.md): Artik Lab develops advanced software for clients when the problem cannot be solved by a dashboard or a standard business application: technical calculations, mathematical models, operational data, expert rules and workflows that need to become verifiable.

## Machine-readable data
- [Courses JSON](https://ar-tik.com/data/courses.en.json): structured course catalog with HTML, Markdown and LLM dossier URLs.
- [Services JSON](https://ar-tik.com/data/services.en.json): structured index of Artik Lab service pages and Markdown mirrors.
- [AI applications JSON](https://ar-tik.com/data/ai-applications.en.json): structured atlas of AI applications for companies, with input, output, value and links.
- [FAQ JSON](https://ar-tik.com/data/faq.en.json): corporate AI FAQ repertoire with questions, answers, intents, signals, risks and next steps.
- [LLM index JSON](https://ar-tik.com/data/llm-index.json): machine-readable manifest for languages, sitemaps and public AI-readable files.
- [LLM sitemap](https://ar-tik.com/sitemap-llm.xml): sitemap for Markdown, dossier, JSON and LLM index files.
- [Full LLM corpus](https://ar-tik.com/llms-full.txt): concatenated public Markdown corpus for agents that prefer a single fetch.
